reviews.review: average game at best only worth playing if you're a big fan of mass effect

A nice change of pace from the original trilogy, focusing mostly on exploration rather than action. While enjoyable, with some really cool systems and abilities in the game, the lack of narrative and urgency from the original trilogy can be felt massively. 

That said, chilling out, driving on a new planet does make for a fun pass time.

EA + Linux = Game works and you buy it, then EA makes game no longer work by making their launcher fail to load the game.

EA is a wealthy and old company due to Gamers. EA, however has no respect for our choices. I've had it with Windows bloat and dictated updates, as well as how "magically" their source code shows up on the Dark Web, and they have millions of people needing to buy a new Windows because of it.

The growing use of LInux shows I am not alone. Games in emulation run better on Linux most of the time. But EA, they don't care about my choices, they care about their buddies and fellow fatcats.

What I don't get is how Steam doesn't require big developers who can afford it to assure compatibility on all platform Steam supports. Steam has put money and resources behind Arch Linux. EA has no excuse but that they are just using Steam as they've done in the past. So, No. I do not recommend this or any other EA game because they do not care about their customers.

And to you "well it's not supposed to run on LInux" folks: I play more games that aren't supposed to run on LInux due to ProtonDB and sometimes my own playing around to make a game work. What difference does it really make what operating system we're on if the game works? And why does EA or any other developer not want to click 1 checkbox and at least make sure the opportunity for the game to run on Linux is there? No matter how small the Linux market is it's still a market and there's no reason to reject our money like it's not good enough, or to just take it and then make the product no longer deliver, no longer play.

Oh and this review is pertinent because other Linux users will want to know EA has made their launcher fail for LInux users with no fix in sight.
